rationale: The task requests a user-visible change to an existing AGDF Pages site, but the synthetic control state contains neither an approved durable UR nor a Brownfield decision. Under fail-closed routing, the earliest permissible stage is UR; Brownfield Review and any delivery-path selection remain unavailable until UR approval and artefact presence are established.
decision_grounds: The task introduces user-visible Pages-site content or behavior concerning AGDF limits, dependencies, and process effort
No durable UR artefact or linked authoritative UR is evidenced
Brownfield Review requires an approved durable UR and therefore is not yet permissible
No Mode/Slice Decision is present, so no delivery path can be evaluated
compact_delivery prerequisites are absent: no visible approved UR, no completed Brownfield analysis, and no stored quick
The eventual_delivery_path candidate is non-operative and does not authorize a path selection
